metadata.title: Crizotinib Monotherapy
metadata.indication: Adult ALK-positive advanced NSCLC: previously treated (00243a) or first-line (00243c); adult ROS1-positive advanced NSCLC (00243b).
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled adult crizotinib pathways · clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: NCCP v7 omits CrCl exactly 30 and describes dialysis dosing as expected. EMA explicitly includes 30 in moderate impairment but its severe renal recommendation excludes dialysis. Do not silently combine reductions or infer a definitive dialysis dose.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_version_change: NCCP remains version 7 (27 January 2025); reconciled to freshly retrieved PDF and current EMA product information. Supplemental EMA changes/conflicts explicitly retained.
source_conflicts: NCCP p2: liver tests every 2 weeks for first 2 months; EMA SmPC 4.4 p11: weekly for first 2 months. Use weekly monitoring pending local reconciliation, then monthly; this supplement is explicit.
NCCP p3 renal table leaves CrCl exactly 30 mL/min unallocated (>30/<30). EMA p9 includes 30 in moderate impairment without starting reduction. Exact 30 and legacy ≤30 band require review.
NCCP p3 expects a 50% original dose in haemodialysis; EMA p9 severe-renal recommendation applies only without haemodialysis/peritoneal dialysis. Dialysis requires specialist individualisation.

NCCP p3 severe hepatic row contains QC alongside explicit 250 mg QD and permits increase if tolerated. EMA p9 specifies 250 mg once daily without a hepatic escalation schedule; do not automate escalation.
NCCP p3 grade 3 QT restart says 200 mg twice daily; EMA adult Table 4 says next lower dose. Existing dose and recurrence must be reconciled before restart.

NCCP p2 ECG every 2 cycles is not a defined time interval in this continuous oral regimen. Do not turn this into a fabricated 21/28-day cycle; arrange an explicit local ECG cadence with periodic ECG/electrolytes per SmPC.
metadata.schedule_summary: The usual adult starting dose is 250 mg twice daily, every day, with no planned rest week. Use the strength and frequency on your own prescription. Treatment continues while it helps and side effects remain acceptable; there is no fixed course length.

source_supplements.label: EMA Xalkori product information: adult NSCLC and patient leaflet
source_supplements.basis: Audited product information supplement; NCCP differences remain explicit

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: All changes require Consultant/pharmacy authorisation. Several actions may apply; do not multiply reductions. Fixed schedule changes are stated in text, without patient-specific automatic dose calculation.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00243 Version 7. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled v0.84.24; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy review remains pending.

eligibility: Adults with advanced NSCLC and accurate validated ALK or ROS1 positivity; select exact 00243a/b/c indication.
ECOG 0–2; Consultant Medical Oncologist initiates treatment.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, ALK/ROS1 confirmation, chest X-ray/CT, clinical review; ECG/electrolytes near first dose per SmPC.
Weekly ALT/AST/bilirubin for first 2 months per current SmPC (NCCP says every 2 weeks), then monthly and more often if abnormal.
NCCP FBC/renal profile and chest X-ray monthly. Disease monitoring per Consultant; confirm local imaging plan.
Periodic ECG/electrolytes, heart rate and blood pressure; NCCP every 2 cycles wording lacks a defined interval in continuous treatment.
Assess infection, lung symptoms, vision, oedema/heart failure, neuropathy, GI effects, adherence and interactions at reviews and promptly if symptomatic.
dose_modifications: Dose levels: 250 mg twice daily → 200 mg twice daily → 250 mg once daily. Permanently discontinue if unable to tolerate 250 mg once daily.
Grade-based adult source tables do not specify a CTCAE edition. Confirm grading and baseline context before applying a restart pathway.
NCCP p2: liver tests every 2 weeks for first 2 months; EMA SmPC 4.4 p11: weekly for first 2 months. Use weekly monitoring pending local reconciliation, then monthly; this supplement is explicit.
NCCP p3 renal table leaves CrCl exactly 30 mL/min unallocated (>30/<30). EMA p9 includes 30 in moderate impairment without starting reduction. Exact 30 and legacy ≤30 band require review.
NCCP p3 expects a 50% original dose in haemodialysis; EMA p9 severe-renal recommendation applies only without haemodialysis/peritoneal dialysis. Dialysis requires specialist individualisation.

NCCP p3 severe hepatic row contains QC alongside explicit 250 mg QD and permits increase if tolerated. EMA p9 specifies 250 mg once daily without a hepatic escalation schedule; do not automate escalation.
NCCP p3 grade 3 QT restart says 200 mg twice daily; EMA adult Table 4 says next lower dose. Existing dose and recurrence must be reconciled before restart.

NCCP p2 ECG every 2 cycles is not a defined time interval in this continuous oral regimen. Do not turn this into a fabricated 21/28-day cycle; arrange an explicit local ECG cadence with periodic ECG/electrolytes per SmPC.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP00243 v7 p4; NCCP classification V6 oral moderate-high Table 8 and prophylaxis Table 5
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
other_supportive_care: Individual daily oral antiemetic prophylaxis under local policy; account for crizotinib QT/bradycardia and CYP3A interactions. No routine continuous steroid or cytotoxic infusion antiemetic bundle.
No routine premedication. Avoid grapefruit and St John’s wort; review every prescription/OTC/herbal medicine.
Hard capsules whole with/without food. Missed dose: take if ≥6 hours until next; otherwise skip. Vomited dose: do not replace.
Adequate contraception during and at least 90 days after treatment for males/females; oral contraception may be less effective. Avoid breastfeeding and discuss fertility preservation.
